title: An operator name in the wrong case
question: Does AWS accept a condition operator spelled in lowercase? AWS doesn't say whether operator names ignore case. The analyzer rejects the policy.

cases.name: lowercase_string_equals
cases.description: stringequals aws:PrincipalTag/campus campus-01, for a caller tagged campus-01.

readings.rejected: AWS refuses the policy, as the analyzer does
readings.IMPLICIT_DENY: AWS accepts the policy, but the condition never holds
